statements.proposition: In useWorkspaceUpdateRole, when previousRole is not provided the code falls back to evicting the whole teamByRole cache field (as before), for both removal and role updates.
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: The eviction fallback exists only in the user-removal branch (!input.role). In the role-update branch (else) with no previousRole, the createUpdatedValue callback does nothing and the field is not evicted, whereas the base code evicted teamByRole unconditionally. So for callers omitting previousRole on a role change, behavior regressed (stale counts), contradicting the unqualified compatibility claim. Partially true for removal only; labelled FALSE because the statement is unqualified.
evidence: PR patch of packages/frontend-2/lib/workspaces/composables/management.ts: the base unconditional modifyObjectField(... 'teamByRole' ... evict()) is removed
head file: evict() on teamByRole appears only at the 'If we don't know the previous role, evict the entire teamByRole field' else-branch inside the !input.role block (lines ~511-517)
head file role-update else-branch (~line 526): 'if (input.previousRole && input.previousRole !== input.role) {...}' with no else/evict, so nothing changes when previousRole is absent
